Core madc must not hardcode special handling for concrete C++ library classes or objects such as std::string, iostream/istream/ostream, sstream, containers, or user classes; behavior should come from standard/embedded headers, generic object/type/overload/mangling/ctor/dtor/retbuf machinery, and real libstdc++ declarations/operators. Embedded polyglot namespace headers and <algorithm> helpers route through ordinary wrappers over explicit extern C ABI declarations. Auto-includes are gated to STD_MADC only, generic range-for local declaration lowering works inside included/header function bodies, extern C/C++ linkage specs parse, function prototypes preserve typedef aliases, declaration-only namespace functions keep default C++ linkage unless inside extern C, PHP string helpers resolve to real php:: C++ namespace symbols, and std::cin >> is recovered on CIR. The latest parser/PCH checkpoint advanced generic real-header parsing far enough to parse iostream/istream/ostream class machinery through class-scope aliases/static member types, nested/template aliases, explicit specialization names, class-qualified expressions, method-result receiver chains, base-qualified calls on this, arity-aware member lookup, contextual type-name shadowing, and K&R recovery guarded by a real old-style declaration suffix.
